raw.description:
QA Automation Engineer (Remote from Brazil)

Job type: Full-time employee

Job ID: 26QAAE202

Description

Serious Development is a boutique healthcare strategy, product, and software engineering firm. We partner with healthcare organizations to solve complex operational challenges through thoughtfully designed custom software.

We are actively seeking a QA Automation Engineer to help us build HealthTech apps and systems for our clients by contributing as a member of one of our agile engineering teams. You’ll help your team increase the reliability of releases through maintaining the application stack’s test automation harness, generating test cases with developers to verify their work, and automating those test cases to continuously regression test code changes. Together with your fellow QA Automation Engineers, you will ensure that our releases are of the highest quality with minimal escaped defects. Overall, you’ll contribute your experience to make your team and the department stronger.

Responsibilities (What you’ll do)

  • Operate as a self-sufficient, T-shaped, QA Automation engineer
  • Review technical architecture documentation for the project and ensure that the engineering team’s deliverables are implemented accordingly
  • Design, implement, maintain, and administer automated test frameworks with results reporting
  • Build new QA automation tests in parallel with development of new user interfaces
  • Support manual QA testing efforts and the conversion of manual test cases into automated test cases
  • Work with the TechOps team to deploy automation tests as part of the CI/CD process
  • Participate in reporting metrics for both manual and automated testing
  • Author and maintain technical documentation and how-to instructions on automation frameworks and scripts
  • Participate in functional and technical reviews
  • Assist in identifying process improvements and application enhancements

●Create and document test plans

  • Collaborate with the development team to plan, create, manage and execute the overall test plan per feature
  • Maximize test coverage for the most critical features and most critical systems.
  • Prioritize automation scenarios based on associated business risk.
  • Investigate, debug and triage problems in automation, and work towards solutions independently or with others in the department, as necessary
  • Identify and report bugs, with clear, efficient steps to reproduce
  • Investigate customer problems referred by technical support
  • Dive into code as technical challenges arise to perform root-cause analyses and implement resolutions
  • Track the progress of defects and work closely with developers or system administrators to ensure they are fixed in a timely manner
  • Ensure quality standards are being met throughout the development and release cycle
  • Participate as a team-player that works together with your fellow team members to deliver commitments on time
  • Work effectively with an internationally-distributed team across multiple time zones

●Develop proofs of concepts as needed

  • Keep current with QA automation engineering best-practices, design principles, technology, security, and compliance in order to apply that knowledge to all of the responsibilities above

Requirements (What we’re looking for)

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar engineering major
  • 2+ years of Quality engineering automation testing experience in a cloud-based environment, excluding internships
  • Manual and automated testing experience in user interfaces and web services
  • Experience with QA automation frameworks, scripting, and coding
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Ability to work across the full technology stack (front-end plus back-end)
  • Experience engineering in linux and/or MacOS environments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Authorization to work in a Brazil, or a LatAm country

raw.description:
On behalf of NDA, Healthcare Support, SD Solutions is looking for a compassionate and dedicated Patient Advocate to help patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities include informing patients of their financial options, responding to patient and client queries, enrolling qualified patients into financial assistance programs, and coordinating the delivery of free medications and assistance payments. To be a successful Patient Advocate, you should be highly empathetic, passionate about the well-being of patients, be driven to achieve set goals, and have a desire to learn more about the healthcare field.

Responsibilities:

  • Enroll patients in philanthropic aid programs.
  • Effectively manage post-enrollment work such as submitting claims or ordering medications.
  • Reviewing patient enrollments for accuracy and completeness.
  • Escalate and appeal patient assistance denials.
  • Order, receive, and log medication orders.
  • Coordinate medication deliveries to the designated pharmacy timely.
  • Always provide exceptional customer service to both the patient and client.
  • Provide patients with information they need to make informed financial decisions about their healthcare.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Atlas products and services.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in a high-performance, high accountability environment.
  • Hands-on experience working in healthcare is a must.
  • High-school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong listening and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficient computer skills.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to offer emotional support and empathy.
  • Have passion for the well-being of patients.
  • Pass standard background check and drug screen.
  • Complete medical clearance per health system requirements (includes vaccination mandates).
  • Remote positions require a distraction free office environment that is HIPAA compliant where Atlas is professionally represented.

Internet Service Requirements:

  • Internet access provided by a cable or fiber provider
  • DSL, satellite, and wireless broadband is NOT permitted; however, in an emergency, if there is an internet outage, your mobile hot spot can be used.
  • Minimum upload speed of 2 mbps.
  • Minimum download speed of 5 mbps.
  • Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of the Work From Home position. You may be asked to upgrade your existing service or switch providers to meet the job requirements.

Modem & Router Requirements:

Our technology department has determined that modem/router combinations (sometimes referred to as a multi-port modem or gateway) often cause connection problems with company issued phones that can prevent connection. You may need to add a router into your network that meets the following guidelines:

  • Ethernet ports wired for gigabit speed connections
  • Availability of at least two (2) Ethernet connections to the internet source is required (for your PC and phone).
  • Your modem or router must either be in the same room as your workspace, or you must have an Ethernet cord long enough to reach your workspace to meet this requirement. Working wirelessly is prohibited.

About the company:

NDA, Healthcare Support is dedicated to helping patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system with ease and confidence. Our mission is to connect individuals with the financial assistance programs and resources they need to access essential medical care. By combining compassionate support with efficient processes, we ensure that patients receive the medications and services they require without unnecessary stress.

Our team works closely with healthcare providers, pharmacies, and financial aid programs to streamline assistance and improve patient outcomes. With a commitment to excellence and patient advocacy, we strive to make healthcare more accessible for everyone.

By applying for this position, you agree to the terms outlined in our Privacy Policy. Please take a moment to review our Privacy Policy , and make sure you understand its contents. If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Privacy Policy, please feel free to contact us.

SAP Fioneer is a fast-growing global company that delivers next-generation software solutions for the financial services industry. As a spin-off from SAP, the market leader in enterprise application software, SAP Fioneer combines cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. Our mission is to bring financial services to the next level through innovative software solutions and platforms, helping companies in the financial services industry achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation and cloud technology.

We are a global company with subsidiaries in multiple countries and a great team of professionals who are passionate about driving change in the financial industry. If you are looking for an opportunity to accelerate your career and be part of a dynamic and innovative company, SAP Fioneer is the perfect place for you to grow and make an impact!

Job location

For this role you can work anywhere in Colombia, with willingness to travel to meet the team on-site from time to time.

About the Role

  • You advise and support SAP Fioneer in all relevant financial and performance management processes and independently manage sub-projects.
  • Using both agile and traditional project methods, you assist in requirements analysis, design, and implementation of customized financial and performance management processes.
  • You drive innovative solutions in the areas of Financial Products Subledger (FPSL) with S/4HANA or integration possibilities for S/4HANA Cloud solutions.
  • Additionally, you provide support in cross-SAP topics and serve as an FPSL expert for clients and colleagues.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 3 years of solid professional experience in the fields of finance, accounting, or performance management within the SAP project environment.
  • Experience with Financial Products Subledger (FPSL) with S/4HANA or integration possibilities for S/4HANA Cloud solutions, specifically for Insurance clients.
  • You possess excellent knowledge of business processes and have experience in the application or design of SAP solutions.
  • You have a quick grasp of concepts and enthusiastically delve into new subject areas.
  • Your strong communication skills, initiative, and ability to work in a team set you apart.
  • Excellent English language skills (oral and written)

Benefits

  • Opportunity to shape the fast-changing financial services landscape.
  • Flexibility to work and gain experience in different areas of the company as you grow your career.
  • Fast-paced start-up type culture with an experienced team, strong brand, and an enviable product portfolio.
  • Work with some of the smartest and most driven individuals around the world.
  • Competitive compensation package and countless growth opportunities.
  • Flexible working policy, so you can work when and where it's comfortable for you.
  • Unparallel impact + Exponential growth + The best of both worlds + Bold innovation + Constant development.
  • Lean hierarchy environment with focus on your growth in providing individual career paths.

raw.description:
Job Title : Information Security Consultant

Role Purpose

Provide expert advisory services to strengthen the enterprises information security posture. Assess risks, recommend solutions, and ensure alignment of security initiatives with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments, security reviews, and gap analyses
  • Develop, review, and recommend security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Align security strategies and initiatives with business goals and regulatory requirements
  • Provide guidance on the design and implementation of security controls and architecture
  • Support regulatory compliance efforts and audit readiness activities
  • Collaborate with IT, risk, and business stakeholders to embed security best practices across projects
  • Deliver clear reports, presentations, and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders

Required Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of experience in information security, risk management, or security consulting
  • Strong knowledge of security frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, GDPR, etc.)
  • Proven experience performing risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, and security advisory work
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to translate complex security concepts into actionable business recommendation

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cloud security architecture and advisory (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor
  • Familiarity with emerging security technologies and threat intelligence
  • Hands-on experience with security architecture design and secure software development practices
  • Prior experience in financial services, critical infrastructure, or highly regulated environments

raw.title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Outcomes

raw.title: Data Entry Operator
raw.excerpt: Eventus exists to support finance teams of midsize and rapidly growing public and private firms with fractional resources.
raw.description:
Eventus exists to support finance teams of midsize and rapidly growing public and private firms with fractional resources. Fundamentally, our clients have the exact same finance needs and requirements for quality as large firms. What they don’t have is the same transaction volume. Therefore, they can’t justify hiring the full-stack, full-time finance and accounting teams they need to achieve the level of quality demanded. This inevitably leads to unmet needs and extra stress.

Over ten years, we’ve built our business by getting our hands dirty and playing a key role in our clients’ financial operations to solve this problem. We can support the entire back-office from basic accounting to providing CFO leadership and or aiding the SEC reporting and listing process. We add value by providing flexibility – the right person (or people) with the right expertise for the job, at the right price. And we do it with a planning process that makes sure clients “measure twice and cut once” ensuring

superior execution.

Responsibilities

  • Keep detailed records of tasks, files, and progress
  • Look over finalized work, reviewing for errors or duplicate entries before turning in the final product
  • Sift through websites for information
  • Inspect reports and sheets of data
  • Submit information into spreadsheets, databases and customer relationship management systems
  • Obtain further information for documents that are deemed incomplete
  • Verify, correct, and delete unnecessary data, or combine data from several source
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Substantial computer skills including word processing, spreadsheets and presentation software, as well as databases and customer database systems
  • Consistent typing accuracy
  • Ability to multitask and attention to detail are critical
  • Comprehensive knowledge of data entry

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Strong attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information.
• Proven ability to multi-task handling numerous priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and detail.
• Demonstrated judgement, problem solving, decision making and documentation skills.
• Excellent organization skills, extremely efficient and can manage time independently.
• Communication proficiency; both in written and verbal skills in English.
• Excellent computer skills; Microsoft Office Suite, i.e.; Word, Excel, and can learn new applications quickly.
• Possesses a strong work ethic, a positive attitude; is open minded, and reliable.
• Knowledge of generally accepted accounting theories, principles, methods, practices, and terminology.
• Knowledge of financial and accounting software applications, preferably Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains or similar mid-level accounting software.
• Ability to analyze account activity, perform accounting research of general issues, and take corrective action when needed.
• Works well independently and within a team

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• High School Diploma or GED required. Associate degree preferred.
• Understanding of basic accounting/bookkeeping principles
• Proficiency in Excel and all Microsoft Office programs
• Excellent communication skills – Written and Verbal
• Ability to multi-task and work in deadline driven environment

Salary: $45,012 – $76,909 / year

Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. You’ll add to your technical credentials and certifications while enjoying a generous, flexible vacation policy and educational assistance. We also have comprehensive leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

Your role in our mission

• Lead Security operational governance activities
- Drive security remediation efforts and SLA/SLO adherence
• Compliance, operationally focused and security driven
• Ensuring delivery excellence in security tooling and business operations (Ensuring avoidance of non-performance / non-compliance leading to contractual penalties).
• Relationship management with Gainwell Technologies suppliers and the client.
• Presentation skills that invoke confidence and provide clear Gainwell messaging
• Create and maintain an account security plan for the selected account(s) and Products
• Manage and report security incidents from start to finish
• Manage audit preparation, facilitation and remediation
• Manage security risks and exceptions
• Ensure knowledge and implementation of security fundamentals, policies, and standards (regulatory and contractual)
• Escalate and resolve security issues
• Coordinate delivery of security metrics and reporting in support of contractual commitment

What we're looking for

• At least 10 years’ experience working in a risk management, audit, security, or technical delivery role
• Bachelor or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Studies, Information Security (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
• Experience with and understanding of the security and auditing regulations
• Experience with audit and compliance programs, including leading audits and remediation efforts
• Experience with HIPAA, NIST, MARS-E/ARC-AMPE, and FedRAMP
• Excellent and effective communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in diverse, multi-national and virtual environments

• Self-motivated and tenacious

• Demonstrate sound judgment and integrity
• Ability to influence delivery personnel in the execution of security and compliance requirements
• Experience as a Security consultant, architect and/or engineer
• Experience in working with security management including information governance and compliance
• Deep understanding and working knowledge of information security industry best practices with hands on experience
• Experience of security processes and standards, in particular NIST 800-53 and/or ISO27001
• Knowledge of security audit and accreditation processes
• Ability to adapt to new security regimes.
• SIMM and SAM working compliance experience

What you should expect in this role

  • Remote position (US only)
  • Opportunities to travel through your work (0-10%)
  • Video cameras must be used during all interviews, as well as during the initial week of orientation
  • The deadline to submit applications for this posting is 9/30/2026

The pay range for this position is $101,300.00 - $144,700.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

raw.description:
We are currently looking for a HealthShare Engineer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support InterSystems HealthShare and IRIS environments, with a focus on platform operations, CI/CD automation, middleware configuration, production support, and secure application delivery across cloud-based environments.

The HealthShare Engineer will work in an Agile/SAFe and DevOps environment, collaborating with technical teams to maintain reliable production and lower-level environments, automate deployments and infrastructure processes, and provide Tier 3 application support.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strategies and solutions to automate operations and streamline software delivery methodologies and technology processes.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines and support backup, recovery, patching, and ADFS integration activities.
  • Manage certificates and certificate updates across production and lower-level environments.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for InterSystems HealthShare applications and related technologies.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and patch InterSystems base software, kits, and associated middleware components.
  • Support OAuth and SSO configuration and integration across application environments.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, with 3-5 years of professional IT and/or federal government contracting experience, including at least 2 years of experience coding or operating production systems.
  • Hands-on experience with InterSystems Caché, IRIS, or HealthShare, including configuring and supporting large middleware applications.
  • Experience automating infrastructure, application testing, and deployments using Jenkins, Ansible, Python scripting, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) processes and working with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including monitoring solutions such as AWS CloudWatch.
  • Knowledge of Unix, Apache, DevOps practices, monitoring and alerting solutions, and Agile methodologies, including SAFe.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to support complex production environments and work effectively across technical teams.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with Splunk, Dynatrace, or similar enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare environments.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification is preferred.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

raw.description:
Our client is a leader in providing affordable health care to a wide array of patients. You will work on a web application that will serve patients’ needs, allow them easier and faster access to necessary healthcare treatments, and speed up the process of approving healthcare insurance. Besides technical challenges laid in front of you, you will also work on a project with a significant social impact.

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Business Analyst to support the development and enhancement of technology products for a healthcare organization. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, working closely with business partners, Salesforce teams, and internal development groups to translate business needs into actionable deliverables. This role requires strong healthcare domain expertise, excellent stakeholder management, and hands-on experience with Salesforce and Athenahealth platforms.

Your day-to-day activities:

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational workflows, and product requirements.
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, stakeholder discussions, workshops, and discovery sessions.
  • Translate complex business requirements into user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Act as a key liaison across business stakeholders, Salesforce teams, and internal product and development teams to ensure alignment on requirements, priorities, and timelines.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce and Athenahealth teams to understand existing workflows, integrations, data requirements, and system dependencies.
  • Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and potential blockers, proactively driving discussions toward resolution.
  • Partner with Product Owners, UX/UI designers, Software Engineers, and QA teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze and document current-state and future-state business processes to identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
  • Support Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and requirement clarification.
  • Define business scenarios and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate delivered functionality against business expectations.
  • Maintain clear, comprehensive documentation and take ownership of follow-ups and action items.

You’re a perfect match if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting software or digital product development.
  • Strong domain expertise in Healthcare, with a deep understanding of US healthcare workflows and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience working with Salesforce, including workflows, integrations, business processes, and data flows.
  • Hands-on experience working with Athenahealth (or similar EHR/EMR platforms).
  • Proven track record in requirements gathering, documentation, and creating deliverables such as User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, BRDs, and Process Flow diagrams.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise system integrations, APIs, data flows, and system dependencies.
  • Practical experience working within an Agile/Scrum product development environment
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Salesforce developers, Engineers, QA, and UX/UI designers).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated ownership mindset with a strong ability to manage ambiguity, track dependencies, and work effectively in remote environments.
Nice to have:
  • Experience supporting the development or enhancement of specialized healthcare technology platforms.
  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare system integrations and REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Proficiency using Jira and Confluence for backlog management and documentation.
  • Experience working across distributed or global cross-functional teams.

Position: Proposal/Capture Manager

Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Travel: 20%

Position Summary: The Proposal & Capture Manager serves as a key member of the Growth & Development team, directly supporting the Director of Growth & Development in executing the company's strategic growth objectives across the Department of Defense, U.S. Army, Special Operations Forces (SOF), Naval Special Warfare (NSW), and related federal markets. This position focuses primarily on opportunity identification, capture execution, customer engagement, and industry partner development. The individual will work closely with company leadership to expand Seventh Dimension's market presence, strengthen strategic relationships, and position the company for future contract awards. Approximately 70% of the role is dedicated to capture management, opportunity shaping, strategic teammate development, market intelligence, and customer engagement activities. The remaining 30% is dedicated to proposal management and business development operations, including coordinating proposal efforts, managing schedules, supporting proposal development, and ensuring timely, compliant submissions.

The ideal candidate is a former military professional with operational experience within Army, SOF, NSW, Intelligence, or related defense organizations and possesses the ability to translate customer needs and mission requirements into actionable growth strategies.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Growth, Capture & Strategic Partner Engagement (70%)

  • Support the Director of Growth & Development in executing strategic growth, capture, and business development initiatives.
  • Identify, research, and track federal opportunities aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Support capture activities by gathering and organizing customer, competitor, and market intelligence.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with government customers, industry partners, and prospective teammates.
  • Assist in identifying and evaluating strategic teaming and subcontracting opportunities.
  • Participate in customer engagements, industry days, conferences, and networking events as required.
  • Maintain opportunity pipeline information and business development tracking systems to ensure data remains current and accessible.
  • Coordinate the internal flow of information and documents supporting capture and business development efforts.
  • Assist leadership with opportunity assessments, pursuit planning, and bid/no-bid activities.

Proposal Management & Business Development Operations (30%)

  • Coordinate proposal schedules, deadlines, deliverables, and review activities.
  • Assist in preparing, formatting, and organizing proposal content, resumes, past performance information, and supporting documentation.
  • Support proposal reviews and ensure action items are tracked through completion.
  • Provide support during production and submission of final proposals to ensure compliance with solicitation requirements.
  • Maintain proposal repositories, templates, lessons learned, and related business development resources.
  • Support reporting, tracking, and other growth-related initiatives as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, English, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and relationship-oriented with a problem-solving mindset.
  • Willingness to travel in support of customer meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
  • Interest in business development, capture management, proposal development, and federal contracting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred: Military experience within the U.S. Army, Special Operations Forces (SOF), Naval Special Warfare (NSW), Intelligence Community, or related operational organizations.
  • Preferred: Existing relationships within the DoD, Army, SOCOM, NSW, Intelligence Community, or defense industry.
  • Preferred: Experience supporting capture management, business development, recruiting, growth initiatives, or proposal efforts.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with federal acquisition processes & government contracting environments.
  • Preferred: Experience identifying, qualifying, or tracking federal business opportunities.
  • Preferred: Experience developing or supporting teaming relationships and industry partnerships.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, CRM systems, GovWin, or similar opportunity-tracking tools.
  • Preferred: Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Physical Demands and Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Company Background: Seventh Dimension LLC provides focused customer support in two core competencies Training & Support Services. Since 2015, we have provided customers with flexible, adaptable, and creative approaches to solving complex problems. We are a proven prime contractor that understands future operating environments, fiscal constraints, and current force requirements. We are a SDVOSB in North Carolina with a TS Facility Clearance, Secret storage and a DCAA compliant accounting system.

 DISCLAIMER: This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” relationship.

 

Seventh Dimension, LLC is a Veteran friendly employer and provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

raw.title: Senior Production Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
raw.description:
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you'd be doing in this role:

This Engineering Manager role leads Embedded, one of Production Engineering's two teams.

You'll lead a technically strong group of engineers, deliberately weighted toward senior talent, working simultaneously across several of Canva's most important production challenges. Right now, those engagements include safeguarding critical data, making software changes safer, building reliability and observability into a major platform rewrite, and building tooling and frameworks to allow services to increase resilience to overload scenarios.

Because Embedded works alongside teams outside your reporting line, the role depends as much on influence as authority. You'll need to earn the trust of engineering leaders quickly, help your engineers navigate different technical and organisational environments, and stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions and shape important technical decisions.

Embedded is still new, so you won't be stepping into a finished playbook. You'll help decide which problems the team takes on, how engagements should work, what great looks like, and how we measure whether Production Engineering is having the impact we intended.

You'll also be responsible for creating an environment where experienced engineers can do their best work: setting direction, building psychological safety, giving direct coaching and helping senior engineers grow their technical and organisational influence.

Looking ahead, this role will help build:

  • Impact where it matters most: Focus Embedded on the production problems where it can make the biggest difference, build trust with engineering leaders so the team is brought in early, and make that impact visible through measurable outcomes.

  • A model that scales: Work out how Embedded can run more engagements without losing the technical bar, coaching quality or close partnerships that make the model effective.

  • Standards worth reusing: Turn lessons from individual engagements into engineering practices, patterns and capabilities that can benefit teams across Canva.

  • The next generation of leaders: Develop senior engineers and engagement leads who can coach others, lead increasingly complex work and multiply the team's impact.

You’re probably a match:

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience:

  • Leading senior engineers: You've led highly experienced software engineers and technical leads through complex or ambiguous work, and know how to coach people operating with significant autonomy.

  • Production exposure: You've worked in software environments where reliability, scalability and production risk genuinely mattered.

  • Earned authority: You've built trust from a standing start, particularly in environments where influence mattered more than reporting lines.

  • Cross-org delivery: You've led significant technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or groups, from understanding the problem through to delivering an outcome.

  • Driving adoption: You've persuaded teams to change how they build or operate software, even when they were busy, skeptical or already had an established way of working.

  • Engineering leadership: You can communicate complex technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders while creating an environment where engineers can challenge ideas, learn, receive direct feedback and do their best work.

Technical knowledge:

  • CS fundamentals: A strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, multithreading and data structures.

  • Language depth: Enough depth in languages such as Go, Python, Java or C++ to engage meaningfully with designs, implementation choices and technical trade-offs.

  • Systems knowledge: Strong working knowledge of system internals, networking and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

  • Systems thinking: Comfortable reasoning through ambiguous problems spanning multiple components, teams and constraints, with a strong understanding of system design, architecture and engineering patterns.

  • Reliability engineering: Familiarity with observability, capacity, failure modes and the operational characteristics of production systems.

  • Scale and criticality: Experience working in large-scale or high-criticality environments where reliability failures have meaningful consequences for users, systems or the business.

Nice to have:

  • SRE/PE management: Prior experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering or a closely related function

  • Infrastructure exposure: Experience with large-scale storage, CDN, networking or distributed infrastructure

  • Growing technical leaders: A history of developing senior engineers and technical leads who can coach others and take on increasingly complex work

  • Function-building: Experience helping define the identity, operating model or scope of a technical function while it was still taking shape

About the Group and Team:

Production Engineering sits within Canva's Reliability Platform subgroup, part of the wider Infra supergroup responsible for the foundations Canva's engineering teams build on, including compute, storage, networking, developer experience and reliability.

At more than 250 million monthly active users, Canva's hardest reliability problems increasingly span systems, teams and organisational boundaries. Production Engineering exists to help keep Canva reliable, efficient and predictable as that complexity grows.

It's primarily a software engineering function. Rather than operating systems from the sidelines or papering over problems with process, Production Engineers solve operational challenges through design and code.

The function is split into two teams: Embedded and Core.

Embedded works directly alongside teams across Canva on targeted, long-running engineering engagements. Engineers typically work in small groups, combining senior technical leadership with engineers who can learn from the engagement and help carry that knowledge forward.

Core owns Production Engineering services and works on broader problems that cut across multiple teams or groups. When an Embedded engagement uncovers an idea worth applying more widely, Embedded and Core can work together to turn that learning into reusable capability across Canva.

Embedded is deliberately weighted toward senior technical talent. Production Engineers need to enter unfamiliar problem spaces, understand complex systems quickly and earn credibility with the engineers who already own them.

Because the function is still taking shape, the team is also defining its own identity: where Production Engineering can have the greatest impact, how it partners with other teams, and how individual wins become lasting engineering capability across Canva.

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and support you personally

Other stuff to know?

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Privacy Notice: At eCore, we’re committed to respecting your privacy. We use Breezy HR, a web-based hiring platform, to assist our recruitment process. As part of that process, we require you to submit a personal information/identification document that will be treated with high confidentiality and shared with authorized hiring team members only. Your identification document is used for screening purposes and your personal information is used to determine whether or not you’re a good fit for current and future roles at our company. Please provide accurate information, otherwise, your application will be disqualified and you will not be able to reapply in the future.

Data Researcher

Employment Type: Contract (Independent Contractor)
Department: Data Management

IMPORTANT TIPS:

  • Read the job requirements and FAQ thoroughly.
  • Apply with Gmail (preferable). If you don’t, you will be asked to provide one before the training. We use Google Workspace and having Gmail is required for all researchers.
  • If your application is declined, you may reapply again in 6 months. If you reapply earlier than that, your application will be disqualified.
  • Do not submit more than one application for the same role. This is considered spamming and all your applications will be blocked.
  • Do not submit application on anyone’s behalf. This is considered fraud and you will be blacklisted indefinitely.

JOB DESCRIPTION & REQUIREMENTS:


About eCore

eCore was founded in 2020 to provide solutions that help companies address economic, competitive, and societal challenges while adapting workforce plans accordingly. We combine innovation, technology, and talent to simplify business processes and increase efficiency.

eCore is a rapidly growing company with a global mindset and a strong commitment to inclusive and respectful collaboration. We are a people-oriented organization that values motivated, well-managed, high-functioning teams.

About the position

We are seeking detail-oriented, computer-savvy individuals to support Korean-language data research projects. This is a 100% remote independent contractor role.

Contractors have the flexibility to determine how and when they complete assigned work, provided agreed project timelines and quality standards are met. Initial onboarding and project coordination support are provided to ensure alignment with project requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver completed lead generation outputs based on Korean-language online research
  • Provide accurate data entry, enrichment, and maintenance deliverables
  • Validate and cleanse datasets according to defined project specifications
  • Ensure research outputs meet documented quality and acceptance criteria

Qualifications:

  • Experience in lead generation, data research, data analysis, or data quality assurance.
  • Prior experience working remotely or in an online environment.
  • Fluent or near-native proficiency in Korean (written and spoken)
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
  • Strong internet research skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Proficiency with productivity tools such as Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and messaging platforms
  • Access to a computer with at least 8GB RAM and a reliable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps download speed)

Contractor Notice

This role is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and legal compliance in their respective country of residence. Compensation is based on completed deliverables.

Why Join eCore?

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule
  • Clearly defined scopes and deliverables
  • Training and coordination support
  • Opportunity to contribute to global data projects

COUNTRIES WE ARE CURRENTLY HIRING FROM: Philippines.

Screening Stages:

  • Pre-qualification
  • Video Interview
  • Data Researcher Training
  • Final test (to qualify for the role)

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How do I know this is not a scam?

  • We're here to connect companies with the global workforce online, and we will never ask you for money. We want to pay you for the work that you've done on our platform. For more information about the company, please visit our website and LinkedIn page:

How should I prepare myself before applying for the role?

  • Prepare a resume that highlights your updated educational background and work experience.
  • Prepare valid identification documents for verification purposes.
  • You need to have at least 10 Mbps download speed for an internet connection. When filling out the application, you’ll be asked to run a speed test on your computer (do not use your phone for the speed test).
  • 8GB computer RAM capacity. It's important that your computer can handle the applications we work with. Your application will be disqualified if your computer RAM and internet connection don't meet the requirements.
  • Make sure your name on the application, ID, and resume match. If we find discrepancies, your application will be disqualified.

Is it safe to submit my ID and personal information?

  • We use the Breezy portal for application tracking. It’s a secure platform that allows us to store and protect your personal information. Only authorized hiring team members have access to applications and attached documents.

What are the steps I need to take in order to get hired?

  1. Click the 'Apply To Position' button and complete the application form.
  2. After you submit all necessary information, you will receive an invite to record a video interview. You will be asked a few questions to help us get to know you better.
  3. The hiring team reviews applications and selects the best-fitting candidates to begin the training program.
  4. If you’re selected, you will receive an invite to start Data Researcher Training. You have 6 days to complete the training materials and 1 day for the final test.
  5. After you pass the Final Test, you will be asked to sign the paperwork.
  6. Once the paperwork is complete, we will verify the validity of your identity, signature, and the information you have provided. If everything looks good, you are officially hired, and the probation period starts.

Is the training paid?

  • No, pre-hire training is not paid. You get paid after you’re officially hired and assigned to a project.

How do I get paid?

  • We pay via Payoneer once a month. Payoneer is a financial services company (similar to PayPal) that provides online money transfer and digital payment services. It connects to your bank account for fast, easy transactions. Please note that Payoneer is not part of eCore Services, and all fees collected by Payoneer are solely determined by them.

I submitted my application, but haven’t received a response. What should I do?

  • We review applications on a first-come-first-serve basis. We try to be efficient and respond in a timely manner, but if we have a high influx of applicants, our response may be delayed. Nevertheless, your application will be reviewed, and you will be notified of the decision. If you don’t receive a decision within 2 months, feel free to reach out to request an update.
Salary: $3.80 – $4.00 / hour

Gaggle builds technology that helps K-12 schools identify student safety and wellness concerns so districts can intervene early, the kind of work our team is proud to say saves lives. We're hiring a detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to handle day-to-day HR operations: leave administration, onboarding and offboarding, compliance documentation, and the everyday work that keeps our employees and contractors covered. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who likes structure and staying on top of the details.

Key Responsibilities

Leave & Accommodation Administration

  • Administer Gaggle's in-house leave program, including tracking usage, documentation, and approvals/denials.
  • Track and apply state-specific paid leave programs that intersect with company leave policy, escalating questions as needed.
  • Provide timely communication of all leave needs with HR and Finance.
  • Maintain documentation for the ADA interactive process.

Employee & Contractor Administration

  • Handle onboarding and offboarding logistics for both employees and contractors, including contractor-specific recordkeeping requirements.
  • Own compliant I-9 verification and documentation for all new hires.
  • Manage background check workflow administration.
  • Own recruiting, candidate inquiries, and job postings.
  • Maintain a running list of state registrations, powers of attorney, and system logins across the states where we have teams.
  • Respond to employment verification requests as they come up.
  • Support the annual handbook review and Gaggle Compliance Month.

Compliance

  • Support required state and federal employment filings, including ACA, EEO-1, and Form 5500, by gathering documentation and tracking deadlines.
  • Assist in maintaining the multi-state contractor classification framework and making teams aware of the implications.
  • Serve as the point of contact for garnishment orders and other court documents, and support unemployment claims in partnership with our claims vendor.

HR Systems & Administrative Support

  • Maintain HR documentation and recordkeeping across systems, including contractor agreements, renewals/expirations, and required documentation.
  • Troubleshoot day-to-day issues with Paychex and other HR-related vendors.
  • Maintain and build out internal HR documentation and resources.
  • Assist with the annual performance review process.
  • Be the point person for routine contractor administration and escalated HR-system issues.
  • Pull and build HR reports, including custom reports, from Paychex as needed.
  • Track and document employee status changes (such as role, location, or classification changes) for recordkeeping purposes.
  • Provide general administrative support to HR and Finance, including vendor coordination, event logistics, holiday gifts, and responding to employer reviews.
  • Cross-train on core processes as needed to maintain continuity across the team.

Employee Relations

  • Serve as an empathetic, approachable first point of contact for employees with day-to-day HR questions or concerns.
  • Accurately and confidentially document any employee concerns that come your way, escalating anything sensitive or beyond routine.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of professional work experience, including 2+ years in HR with multi-state exposure.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment fundamentals.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable navigating Paychex (or a similarly complex HRIS platform) for day-to-day administration, including pulling standard and custom reports.
  • Hands-on experience with I-9 verification, unemployment claims, or wage garnishment processes.

Preferred

  • PHR (HRCI) or SHRM-CP certification, or actively working toward one.
  • Experience supporting contractor workforce administration.
  • Solid understanding of employee benefits (health, dental, vision, 401(k)).
  • Notary Public commission, or willingness to obtain one.

Core Competencies

  • You work independently and take full ownership of your tasks without needing close supervision.
  • You're detail-oriented, taking a "measure twice, hammer once" approach to ensure accuracy.
  • You look for what needs to get done or could be improved rather than waiting to be told.
  • You work through tasks quickly and consistently, rather than letting things pile up.
  • You're a self-directed learner who enjoys figuring out new systems and processes.
  • You want what is best for people, and it shows every time someone comes to you.

Salary Range and Benefits

Please apply to this posting in order to learn more about the starting salary range and benefit options. Some benefits highlights:

  • We’re a remote-first company; our team works together across all 50 US states
  • PPO and HDHP health insurance plans through BCBS of Illinois; coverage includes treatment for fertility (including IVF) as well as offering virtual visits and mental health resources
  • Dental insurance (including orthodontia) through Guardian
  • Vision insurance through BCBS/EyeMed
  • HSA, FSA, LPFSA, and DCFSA available, with a $500 annual company contribution
  • 401(k) plan with immediate vesting and a 4% company contribution with each paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program through Paychex and Guardian (includes financial and legal assistance)
  • Flexible PTO
  • Generous, 100% to 70% paid leave plans, up to 90 days
  • Pet Insurance Discount Program
  • Fun perks such as team recognition programs, holiday gifts and bonuses, raffles, and fantasy football leagues

Our Team Commitment

Gaggle is proud to be recognized as a 2023 Top Workplace and also a proud recipient of the 2024 Top Workplaces USA Today award. We are committed to equal opportunity without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, or sex.

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

QA Engineer, Web and Mobile

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

Salary: €5000 per month

Location: Poland (Fully Remote)

The role

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

What you will do

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.

Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.

Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.

Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.

Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.

Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.

What we are looking for

  • Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

  • Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

  • You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

  • Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

  • Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

  • Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

  • Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

  • Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

  • Accessibility testing (WCAG).
