Product Marketing Manager, Autonomous Networks

Location: UK / Kuala Lumpur

Department: Communications & Marketing

About TM Forum

TM Forum is a global alliance of more than 850 communications service providers, vendors, hyperscalers and system integrators, together generating US$2 trillion in revenue and serving five billion customers across 180 countries. We unite these diverse communities to drive end-to-end change, putting the sector at the heart of the global connected economy and providing an open platform for innovation and growth.

We are seeking a hands-on Product Marketing Manager to lead marketing for TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks Mission. This role is ideal for someone who understands the realities of modern network operations and has relevant telecommunications experience gained within a communications service provider (CSP), technology or network vendor, systems integrator (SI), OSS/BSS provider or telecommunications consultancy.

You will help articulate the industry vision for autonomous operations, create compelling market narratives and drive engagement with the frameworks, benchmarks, best practices, collaborative projects and industry assets shaping the future of AI-powered network operations. Working closely with Mission leaders, member companies and technical experts, you will translate complex industry initiatives into impactful marketing programmes that accelerate adoption and demonstrate member value.

What you’ll do:

  • Work with the Director of Product Marketing and Autonomous Networks Mission leadership to develop and deliver the Mission marketing strategy and go-to-market plan.

  • Develop clear, compelling messaging and positioning that connects the industry’s network complexity, operational and commercial challenges with the value of autonomous operations.

  • Create executive-level narratives and thought leadership around Autonomous Networks, AI-powered operations, network automation, autonomous domains and the Autonomous Enterprise.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive, commercial and technical audiences.

  • Plan and execute campaigns supporting Autonomous Networks initiatives, industry assets, benchmarks, certifications, Catalysts and member collaboration programmes.

  • Create high-quality marketing materials including industry reports, white papers, case studies, customer stories, blogs, presentations, executive briefings, webinars and website content.

  • Work closely with Mission owners, product management, technical experts, member engagement, sales, communications and events teams to align product development and collaboration activity with market needs.

  • Monitor market developments across Autonomous Networks, AIOps, intent-driven operations, service assurance, orchestration, closed-loop automation, OSS transformation and AI-native operations.

  • Conduct market, customer and competitive research to identify emerging opportunities, adoption barriers and content priorities.

  • Represent TM Forum and the Autonomous Networks Mission at DTW-Ignite, regional events, webinars and relevant industry conferences.

  • Move confidently between the big picture and hands-on delivery, producing high-quality practical outputs within short timeframes.

  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, members and stakeholders at all levels across a global organisation.

  • Manage multiple priorities with strong analytical, planning and organisational discipline.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in product marketing, solution marketing, portfolio marketing, industry marketing or a closely related role within telecommunications or technology.

  • Relevant domain knowledge gained within a CSP, technology or network vendor, SI, OSS/BSS provider or telecommunications consultancy.

  • Strong understanding of network operations and operational transformation, with knowledge of areas such as OSS, service assurance, orchestration, network management, automation or service operations.

  • Experience translating complex technical propositions into differentiated, customer-focused messaging and clear business value.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and storytelling skills in English.

  • Proven ability to create influential content for both executive and technical audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, organisations and geographies.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

  • A dynamic and flexible attitude, combined with the confidence to engage people at all levels.

Experience that would set you apart:

  • Direct experience of Autonomous Networks, AI-driven operations, AIOps, network automation, intent-based networking or closed-loop operations.

  • Familiarity with TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks vision, maturity levels, frameworks, benchmarks or certification programmes.

  • Knowledge of TM Forum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA), Open APIs, cloud-native technologies and microservices architectures.

  • Experience marketing OSS, assurance, orchestration, network automation, AI, data analytics or operational transformation solutions.

What success looks like:

  • Increased awareness and understanding of TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks Mission across the global telecommunications industry.

  • Growth in member engagement with Autonomous Networks collaboration, assets, benchmarks and industry programmes.

  • A clear, differentiated and consistent Autonomous Networks narrative across campaigns, events, web content, sales enablement and thought leadership.

  • A strong pipeline of member stories, use cases and market evidence demonstrating progress towards higher levels of autonomous operation.

  • TM Forum increasingly recognised as the industry convenor and authority helping CSPs and their partners advance towards Autonomous Networks and the Autonomous Enterprise.

Why Join TM Forum?

  • Work at the centre of one of the telecommunications industry’s most significant transformation programmes, collaborating with the organisations shaping the future of AI-powered network operations.

  • Influence an entire industry ecosystem rather than marketing a single product, helping define how CSPs progress from assisted automation towards autonomous operations.

  • Build recognised thought leadership and contribute to practical frameworks, benchmarks and collaboration that accelerate industry-wide change.

  • Benefit from opportunities for professional development and advancement in a collaborative global team.

Join a supportive and inclusive work environment that values creativity, innovation and diversity. We know that sometimes the ‘perfect candidate’ doesn’t exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they don’t fit all the requirements. If you’re excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience, we’re looking for, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need! We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed.

Diversity & Inclusion at TM Forum

At TM Forum, we’re building a workplace where everyone can belong, feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome talent from all walks of life to join our global community, which is made stronger by the different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences each person brings. We hire based on skills, potential and values, never on assumptions about who someone is or where they come from. We actively work to ensure our recruitment and people practices are fair, inclusive and free from bias.

About the Job

Do you remember the teacher who went above and beyond to help you realize your potential? At Vanguard College Prep, we are looking for educators ready to pay that forward. Where other test prep companies hire part-time gig workers to teach 'hacks,' we hire full-time professionals to build lasting core skills. We don't run an assembly line; we treat every student as an individual, preparing them for top-tier colleges and beyond.

Compensation:

  • Base Pay: $20.00 – $24.00 / hour (40 hours/week)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO), paid sick days, plus fully paid winter vacations

What You Will do:

  • Teach and Inspire: Instruct small groups of students in their English core skills to promote long-term understanding of topics and top scores in their college readiness exams (ACT & SAT).
  • Track Growth: Track your students’ progress as they move through Vanguard’s unique multi-phase curriculum, engaging students in individualized growth and improvement opportunities along the way.
  • Manage and Model: Maintain and update student lesson schedules, hold them accountable for assignments, and model professionalism along with strong organizational skills through timely student communication.
  • Innovate: Spearhead the development and creative execution of ever-evolving lesson plans and curriculum.
  • Mentor: Guide middle and high school students with empathy and an innate understanding that the college application process is becoming increasingly competitive and stressful.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities field from US Schools (English, Creative Writing, Journalism, Publishing, etc.) (Master’s or higher preferred)
  • Teaching experience in English and/or experience working in a college-level Writing Center (1+ years)
  • Demonstrated academic excellence (e.g., 3.5+ GPA).
  • Strong verbal skills and mastery of the English language
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, and G-Suites
  • Access to a reliable internet connection and a workspace with minimal noise/distraction
  • Commitment to work during Hours of Operations:
    • Mondays and Fridays: Closed
    • Tuesdays to Thursdays: 1:30 pm CST to 9:30 pm CST
    • Saturdays and Sundays: 9:30 am CST to 5:30 pm CST

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • Experience teaching at the college or community college level
  • Robust understanding of classroom pedagogy and the ability to create customized, engaging lesson plans that use practical, real-world examples to inspire a love for learning
  • Desire to help students recognize, reach for, and realize their fullest potential
  • A dynamic and outgoing personality
  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment

Why you want to teach with Vanguard College Prep:

  • Paid training and comprehensive preparation
  • Distinctive and individualized approach to test prep with a strong track record of producing top-tier students and nationally-ranked test scores
  • Opportunity to work with our distinctly engaged, enthusiastic, and driven client base of students energized by Vanguard’s commitment to the highest-quality client experience
  • Elite team of instructors, counselors, and specialists from top universities across the nation who are passionate about fostering student success
  • Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and leadership, with opportunities for long-term career growth
  • Competitive compensation structure (dependent on experience) with benefits

About Vanguard College Prep:

​​Vanguard College Prep is a full-service educational company whose mission is to enable the future leaders of our globalized world to meet their fullest potential. Through its test prep, college counseling, and college essay services, Vanguard is committed to providing meaningful, all-encompassing college preparation that treats each student as an individual, preparing them for the boardroom, not the assembly line.

Two things set Vanguard apart from other after school companies: our elite team and our personalized, organic curriculum. Unlike other test prep companies, which often take a one-size-fits-all approach to test prep, Vanguard recognizes that every student learns differently. Our experienced instructors and counselors strive to shatter this assembly line model by focusing on core learning rather than short-term strategies and tips, tailoring instruction to fit each student’s individual needs. We encourage students’ continual questioning and curiosity with the goal of extending learning beyond the classroom, so that our students will be successful in the elite college of their choice and beyond.

Salary: $20 – $24 / hour

Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Independent Contractor
Schedule: U.S. Eastern Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Lead Graphic Designer to join our client, a growing natural hair care consumer goods brand.

This is a hands-on design role where you’ll personally create and deliver the majority of the brand’s visual work each week while also providing creative direction and coordinating freelancers and vendors when needed.

You’ll work directly with the company owner and collaborate closely with the website developer, printers, freelancers, and other external partners to ensure high-quality, brand-consistent creative is delivered on time.

This is not a delegation-only leadership role. We’re looking for a designer who leads through strong creative execution and can confidently balance production with creative direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and deliver production-ready creative across:
    • Email campaigns
    • Landing pages and website graphics
    • Digital and social media ads
    • Product packaging
    • Trade show materials, including banners, flyers, brochures, booth graphics, and signage
  • Collaborate directly with the website developer and provide complete design specifications, assets, fonts, dimensions, and other required details.
  • Review implemented web and landing page designs against the original designs before launch.
  • Develop fresh creative concepts and proactively recommend new visual directions for the brand.
  • Create both clean, polished corporate designs for retail/B2B audiences and bold, unconventional creative for consumer campaigns, social media, and events.
  • Maintain strong brand consistency across all creative materials.
  • Prepare print-ready artwork according to vendor specifications, including bleed, resolution, and color profiles.
  • Coordinate and review overflow work from freelancers and vendors when required.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines, proactively communicating any potential delays.
  • Maintain an organized library of working files, final artwork, and brand assets.

Requirements

  • Extensive, hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Working knowledge of InDesign and Acrobat.
  • Proven experience designing for a consumer goods company, including packaging, retail materials, and consumer-facing campaigns.
  • Ability to provide examples of brands you have designed for and demonstrate the work in your portfolio.
  • Experience designing complete email campaigns for both desktop and mobile.
  • Experience designing landing pages and websites and successfully handing designs off to developers.
  • Previous experience leading design projects while remaining personally responsible for producing the work.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Reliable computer capable of running Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Stable, high-speed internet connection.
  • Availability to work during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Portfolio Requirement

A portfolio is required to be considered for this position.

Your portfolio should demonstrate a range of design styles and include:

  • At least one clean/corporate design
  • At least one bold or unconventional design
  • At least one email campaign/design
  • At least one landing page or website design
  • Consumer goods/packaging work

Portfolios showing only one design style may not advance in the hiring process.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with beauty, hair care, or personal care brands
  • Trade show or live event design experience
  • Familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, Figma, or Canva
  • Experience with After Effects or Premiere Pro

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a designer who is:

  • Highly creative and visually strategic
  • Detail-oriented and committed to brand consistency
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines
  • Confident communicating with developers, printers, freelancers, and vendors
  • Comfortable giving and receiving direct creative feedback
  • Proactive about bringing new ideas and design trends to the brand

Work Arrangement

  • Full-time, fully remote
  • Must be available for scheduled video check-ins during U.S. Eastern business hours
  • Time-tracking software is used for remote staff

raw.description:
ION is looking for a Director of Paid Media to own paid-media strategy and performance end-to-end across HIP and Neon Canvas: Google Ads (Search, Performance Max), Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and retargeting, for a portfolio of orthodontic and dental lead-generation partners. If you've led paid media at scale, unified two brands, and want a seat where you set the standard instead of following one, we want to talk.

This is not a hands-on-keyboard media buying role.

The best fit has already run a paid-media function at a similar-size agency, managing 500-plus client accounts, and has personally unified two brands or logos under one umbrella. You won't be building campaigns in the ad accounts; your Team Leads and their specialists own that. Your job is to lead the leaders, set the strategy, own the numbers, and keep HIP and Neon Canvas ahead of every competing agency.

As Director of Paid Media, you'll lead the paid-media Team Leads, unify HIP and Neon Canvas into a single operating standard, and own client retention, delivery margin, and function growth. You'll also own innovation for the seat: scouting new ad surfaces and formats, and driving AI enablement across the paid teams, in step with the Sr. Director of Operations on company-wide AI direction.

If you're a leader of leaders who thinks in playbooks, margin, and what's next, this role was built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Set the paid-media strategy, playbook, and Google/Meta channel mix for HIP and Neon Canvas.
  • Own KPI attainment (ROAS, CPL, CTR by vertical), pacing, and budget governance across both brands.
  • Drive one set of standards, tooling, ad-ops processes, and QA across HIP and Neon Canvas.
  • Own escalations, QBRs, and strategy for big partners and new-logo pursuits.
  • Own the service line's P&L (revenue and margin), pricing and packaging, utilization and capacity, and growth and expansion.
  • Run pre-sales scoping and support sales as the function's expert on paid pitches and proposals.
  • Own org design, leveling and career paths, comp-band input, succession and bench planning, and the function's onboarding and L&D.
  • Manage the function's vendors, contracts, and SLAs; own its budget; own risk, compliance, and brand safety at scale.
  • Track emerging ad surfaces and formats (ChatGPT ads, Apple Maps ads, AI creative, new bidding and automation) and define how HIP and Neon Canvas adopt them ahead of competitors.
  • Lead AI enablement across the paid teams, tools, workflows, and training, leaning on the Sr. Director of Operations for company-wide direction.
  • Run 1:1s with each Team Lead for coaching, scorecard review, and unblocking; personally work the handful of at-risk or sliding partners while the leads own the rest.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've run a paid-media function at a similar-size agency, managing 500-plus client accounts, and can hit the ground running from day one.
  • You've personally led paid media across two brands or logos operating under one umbrella, and can speak to how you unified standards, tooling, and reporting.
  • You're a leader of leaders, not just a leader of specialists; you know how to hire, level, coach, and hold other managers accountable.
  • You think in scorecards, margin, and pacing, and you can spot where a portfolio is at risk before it shows up as churn.
  • You're commercially literate; P&L, utilization, and growth aren't foreign concepts; they're how you already think about the function.
  • You're comfortable in the room with leadership, sales, and big partners, and you can deliver a QBR or handle an escalation with confidence.
  • You're genuinely energized by what's next; new ad platforms, formats, and AI tools excite you, not overwhelm you.
  • You hold your Team Leads to a high bar because you hold yourself to one.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

  • 2+ years as a Director of Paid Media or equivalent at an agency of similar size and scope, managing 500+ client accounts.
  • Direct experience unifying paid media across two brands or logos under one umbrella.
  • 6+ years in paid media across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max) and Meta, including lead-generation for local service businesses; orthodontic or dental experience is a strong plus.
  • 2+ years leading other managers, not only individual specialists.
  • Deep platform mastery and strong analytics and experimentation skills.
  • Proven change-management ability and comfort unifying two brands or teams.
  • Commercial literacy, including delivery margin, utilization, and growth, and experience partnering with sales.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills

COMPENSATION

This role includes base pay plus variable compensation.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental Insurance
  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO eligibility after 90 days of hire (10 vacation days the first year of service, unlimited PTO starting year two, flexible partial days, and sick/ personal days)
  • Remote position (You MUST be located in the US.)

SCHEDULE

  • 8 am- 5 pm CST
  • Monday to Friday

  • Take ownership of the estimating function and work with minimal supervision

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of overall estimating experience and 2 years in kitchen and joinery estimating
  • Australian joinery industry experience
  • Experience working on residential projects, with some exposure to commercial or shopfitting
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Proven ability to handle tenders and detailed project costing
  • Proactive, organized, and capable of managing responsibilities independently
  • Long-term mindset and commitment to contributing to the business

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work

Seeking Telemedicine Family/Internal Medicine Providers

Circle Medical is an adult-only primary care practice committed to the empanelment of primary care providers resulting in high quality, continuity of care for our patients through a telemedicine-first approach. We are an evidence-based practice that leverages our proprietary, HIPAA-compliant EHR that ensures a delightful and safe experience for patients and providers via two-way, video-audio appointments.
Please find out more about us on our website.

Pay is a fee-for-service, PCPs earn $50 (MD/DO) per patient encounter, respectively, with appointments ranging from 15 to 30 mins. Earning potential is limitless with our robust incentive programs for top-performing PCPs.

*** Applicants must reside in the United States of America.

We deliver a true Primary Care Experience rooted in provider empanelment and continuity of care

We are a 7-day-a-week operation offering PCPs the freedom to set their own reoccurring schedules within any combination of days, including evenings and weekends.

PCPs are also supported by a strong team of patient care advocates and a licensed medical team who work with you to ensure our patients get the care and follow-up they need. We require a high degree of technical skill utilizing software and an open mind to fast-paced improvements driven by our product and engineering teams. We are in network with most PPO insurance plans and help our patients understand their coverage so that providers can focus on what is most important.

Education & licenses required for this position

  • Completed an accredited nursing or medical program with a national certification
  • Currently licensed in Vermontwith the ability to obtain additional state licenses as needed
  • Valid Vermont DEA Registration in good standing with all schedules to prescribe medications, including S2
  • Ideal candidates will have experience as primary care providers in a clinical setting
  • At least 2 years post-residency practice experience is strongly preferred
  • Must be Board Certified in Family or Internal Medicine
  • Commitment to evidence-based medicine
  • Willingness to learn how to diagnose and treat a variety of adult/primary care conditions
  • A PC with Windows 11 Pro or a Mac newer than 2021 is required
Salary: $100 – $200 / hour

raw.description:
At Veracity, we aim to be a different kind of insurance partner – one that is free from outside investors, venture capital, or the pressures of a corporate parent.

Ours is a culture of empowerment – one that believes in effort, results, and accountability. We believe that transparency fosters trust, trust fosters growth, and that growth drives innovation. Our commitment to rigorous evaluation and relentless execution lead to rapid evolution.

We answer only to the small business owners we serve, and this independence allows us to stay focused on what matters most: helping their businesses thrive by providing expert guidance and best-in-class insurance policies.

We’re growing fast and want you to be a part of it!

We’re seeking a talented, detail-oriented Commercial Insurance Account Manager to join our team. Reporting to the Director of Retail Agency Operations, this remote role will be responsible for managing a portfolio of commercial insurance clients, supporting policy servicing and renewals, driving retention and cross-sell opportunities, and delivering a high-quality client experience throughout the policy lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring a smooth transition from the sales process through onboarding, policy servicing, and renewal
  • Communicate policy details, coverage expectations, service processes, and business relationship expectations throughout the policy term
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing proactive support and ongoing account management
  • Respond to client inquiries, answer coverage questions, process endorsements, and assist with claims, audit, and inspection-related inquiries
  • Manage client accounts throughout the policy term by processing policy adjustments and resolving issues in a timely manner
  • Coordinate with underwriters, carriers, and internal teams to resolve policy and account issues while ensuring a consistent client experience
  • Monitor upcoming renewals and proactively engage clients to review coverage needs and changes in their business operations
  • Conduct consultative renewal reviews and recommend coverage adjustments that support retention and client satisfaction
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell bundled or complementary insurance products based on client needs and business objectives
  • Introduce additional insurance solutions that align with client growth and evolving coverage requirements
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in HubSpot, AMS, and other applicable systems, including interactions, policy updates, and referral information
  • Ensure data integrity and timely documentation to support reporting, account visibility, and business decision-making
  • Generate referrals by delivering exceptional service and cultivating strong client relationships
  • Partner with sales, underwriting, carrier, and customer service teams to support client needs and facilitate issue resolution
  • Maintain knowledge of commercial insurance products, carrier underwriting guidelines, and industry best practices
  • Participate in carrier training, product education, and Learning & Development initiatives to maintain technical proficiency and compliance
  • Adhere to licensing requirements, operating procedures, and company standards for account management, customer engagement, CRM usage, and policy servicing
  • Required to perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience in commercial insurance account management, insurance sales, or a related client-facing insurance role
  • Strong knowledge of commercial insurance products, coverages, and underwriting principles
  • Understanding of the insurance needs of small and mid-sized businesses
  • Strong consultative relationship-building and customer service skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple client relationships and priorities
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with CRM and insurance agency management systems, including AMS platforms preferred
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, virtual meeting platforms, and standard business software
  • Ability to communicate policy information and coverage recommendations clearly and effectively
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development within the insurance industry

Perks

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Amazing work-life balance with 4 weeks of Paid Time Off
  • 10 Paid Company Holidays with 2 floating holidays
  • 401K Programs with employer match
  • Personal assistance programs for support in a healthy personal and work life

Why Veracity?

Here at Veracity, you’ll be part of a team of trailblazers and visionaries. We’re not just revolutionizing the way people “do” insurance; we are creating a whole new paradigm. Here, you will experience a vibrant and inclusive workplace where your ideas matter! With us, you have a chance to:

  • Engage in groundbreaking projects that are reshaping the insurance landscape
  • Collaborate with a group of dedicated, like-minded professionals
  • Experience a culture that prioritizes growth and development

Compensation Range: $80k/yr + Commission

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

If you need accommodation, please let us know during the interview process.

raw.description:
About the Role

ILO Group is seeking an accomplished and strategic Senior Managing Director to lead the development of innovative, high-quality instructional materials that advance learning outcomes and align with state standards. The Senior Managing Director will oversee the design, alignment, and implementation of curriculum and instructional frameworks across multiple projects, guiding a team of content experts and partnering closely with state and district leaders to ensure every deliverable reflects clarity, rigor, and instructional excellence.

Who we are

ILO Group is a proudly women-owned education strategy and policy firm. We are a dedicated team of strategic partners and specialists who support school districts and states in executing on their biggest bets and their highest priority efforts. We work as members of our partners' teams—operating side-by-side with the country’s leading educators, experts, and government partners.

Our work is as diverse as our partners’ ambitions are bold: we work across leadership development, comprehensive project management and implementation support, systems transformation, and more. We enable education leaders to be catalysts for enduring change that benefits their students, schools, and communities. In addition to technical assistance to districts and states, our expert team provides the capacity and expertise to power difference-making partnerships of our own: Women Leading Ed and The Forum for Educational Leadership.

Why ILO Group

Our clients are state education agencies, school districts, and adjacent education organizations, including nonprofits and foundations, who are committed to implementing initiatives that improve student outcomes. In this role, you will work directly with these leaders and their teams to design, develop, and deliver high-quality instructional resources that can be implemented at scale.

You will join a team of high-performing and collaborative individuals who value excellence and integrity. As a senior member of the organization, you will have the opportunity to shape ILO Group’s instructional design strategy, expand our curriculum-focused offerings, and influence the future of teaching and learning at a systems level.

Opportunity

Strategic and Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as lead to ILO Group’s curriculum design and content projects, ensuring all materials meet rigorous instructional quality standards and are aligned to state frameworks.
  • Serve as a key member of the leadership team, helping to shape organizational priorities, manage firmwide strategy, and model ILO Group’s core values.
  • Oversee major internal initiatives that strengthen ILO Group’s expertise and reputation in curriculum and instruction.
  • Contribute to business development by cultivating strategic partnerships, identifying new opportunities, and supporting the growth of ILO Group’s client portfolio.

Curriculum Design and Content Expertise

  • Lead the design, development, and refinement of curriculum content, instructional materials, and educator resources across multiple grade bands and content areas.
  • Ensure all content is aligned with applicable state standards, integrates best practices in pedagogy, and reflects diverse perspectives and inclusive learning principles.
  • Develop frameworks, templates, and quality assurance systems to maintain consistency and rigor across projects.
  • Provide expert guidance to clients and internal teams on curriculum adoption, implementation, and scaling.
  • Serve as a thought leader on instructional design, contributing to ILO Group’s national presence in the education field.

Client and Project Management

  • Manage large-scale client engagements from inception through implementation, including scope, staffing, workplan, budget, and deliverables.
  • Provide strategic counsel to senior education leaders and state agency officials, guiding decisions related to curriculum quality, alignment, and adoption.
  • Anticipate client needs, address risks proactively, and ensure seamless communication between ILO and client teams.
  • Translate complex educational frameworks and research into actionable, “client-ready” products and recommendations.

People Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead a team of curriculum developers, content specialists, and consultants to deliver on time and at the highest level of quality.
  • Serve as a mentor, coach, and role model across the organization, fostering a culture of accountability, feedback, and continuous learning.
  • Identify and nurture opportunities for collaboration between curriculum, leadership development, and research teams.

Thought Leadership and Knowledge Sharing

  • Engage in national and state education networks to stay informed on emerging trends, policy shifts, and research in curriculum and instruction.
  • Share insights and best practices internally to strengthen ILO Group’s service quality and thought leadership.
  • Represent ILO Group publicly as a curriculum design expert through publications, presentations, or professional convenings.

About You

The requirements of the position are:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Education, Curriculum and Instruction, or related field preferred.
  • Experience:
    • 12–15+ years of professional experience, including at least 5 years leading curriculum design, content development, or instructional strategy initiatives at the district, state, or organizational level.
    • Demonstrated success managing large-scale curriculum development or standards alignment projects.
    • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and cultivate long-term client partnerships.
  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Deep expertise in curriculum design, content development, and instructional standards alignment.
    • Strong understanding of the K–12 education landscape, including state standards, assessment systems, and instructional best practices.
    • Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to present confidently to senior audiences.
    • Strategic thinker with strong analytical and organizational abilities.
    • Adept at balancing big-picture strategy with hands-on project execution.

Compensation

Salary starts at $155,000, depending on experience and qualifications, with full benefits and profit-sharing opportunities included.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ILO Group is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
